title: Both Rooks on the Back Rank
setup: Black's king sits on e8 with pawns on c5 and h3, and your rooks command the fifth rank and the a-file.
hint: One rook already owns the file the king would use. Give the other one the rank it needs, without checking.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Ra7}} takes the seventh rank quietly, leaving Black nothing that stops {{Rd8#}}. {{Rd8#}} follows on the back rank. Two rooks mate by taking two ranks — the trick is taking the second one in silence.
